The Chinese characters for Albert

As a transliteration, Albert is usually written 阿尔伯特 (Ā ěr bó tè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

The name Albert has Germanic roots and means “noble and bright”.

About the name Albert

Albert Einstein, the physicist who developed the theory of relativity, carried this name.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “noble and bright”, an Albert calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
